limitations: The native selector branches were reviewed at exact public source pins, not newly executed.
16 retained state/result digests are an excerpt; original full states were not obtained or replayed here.
All 1441 original provider/native objects and streams were not independently authenticated here.
No real-user task cohort, monetary invoice, complete human cost or stable matched-pool economic comparison is present.
Supplied objective dominance does not imply measured controller-runtime or total-task dominance.
Only the configured scalar single-owner profile is characterized, not other NDU algorithms.

controllers.fixed: first candidate that satisfies the exact quality gate
controllers.greedy: minimum immediate measured native-call time among quality-qualified candidates
controllers.ndu: source-pinned native NDU ranks the identical feasible set, cost, uncertainty and remaining budget
controllers.ordinary: enumerate every quality-qualified candidate using complete conservative remaining lifecycle cost and the original remaining budget

multistep_protocol.execution_order: calibration then heldout; registered deterministic rotation of arm order by task index

matched_opportunities.fit_rule: per-arm median of prior successful calibration adoption+rollback costs; uncertainty is observed range plus one millisecond. With no successful calibration, all arms use the same registered two-ms transition prior and ten-ms uncertainty; these are estimates, not measured costs.
matched_opportunities.training_or_external_tuning: none; no arm receives additional examples, hidden solutions, provider calls or optimization passes

measurement.token_policy: input+output+reasoning conservative sum; terminal audit only, no claimed hard mid-turn cap

proposal_reservation.known_insufficient_allowance: record stop_proposals without a new provider dispatch; preserve existing qualified pool for selection, adoption, use and rollback
proposal_reservation.minimum_next_round_tokens: preceding settled actual input+output+reasoning bill; no historical estimate before first round
proposal_reservation.unknown_cost_or_settlement: freeze provider and later cells; never substitute zero

multistep_protocol.provenance: private synthetic maintenance; no real user repository ticket
multistep_protocol.quality: Actual selected native artifact must return all 256 independently specified u8 results and be strictly smaller than the frozen baseline; an unchanged baseline cannot deliver the maintenance task.
multistep_protocol.turn_policy: Three scheduled proposals maximum for every arm; each sees its own previous actual errors and measurements. No automatic repair, refund, task replacement or retry beyond those rounds. Stop on unknown provider/protocol/cleanup outcomes.

research_kind: historical read-only reassessment plus source-derived selector audit

retained_cost_and_scope.capability_statement: All 32 original JSONL streams contain only agent_message items. No actual tool item was observed. The complete effective feature set and complete isolation were not attested.
retained_cost_and_scope.exact_scope: One same-selector/low-reasoning proposal and ordinary-choice call per source-authored synthetic task arm, through an explicitly pinned launch adapter. Local in-process HIA, not formal MCP or a first-use maintenance run.
retained_cost_and_scope.gain_interpretation: Fixed delivered only 2/8. This arithmetic wall difference is not a gain over a completed control, and no arm completed all eight tasks. NDU economic benefit remains false.

cost.dependency_cache_state: not independently measured; acquisition charged if incurred
cost.scope: build() entry through pinned-source extraction, staging, Cargo, source/tool/binary validation and receipt preparation; excludes final receipt write, Python imports and caller startup

historical_native_ndu_build.current_use_scope: Current identity checks, seven NDU evaluator invocations and ordinary task-native emissions are included in original controller/emission/task and outer costs. Historical build acquisition is a separate boundary, not a free cold-start claim.

retained_cost_and_scope.token_convention: Original five counters retained. Source budget conservatively adds input+output+reasoning; cached input is not added again. No independent reasoning-overlap or billed-token attestation.

campaign.cpu_scope: Supervisor parent; waited child plus reaped descendant accounting reported by Linux. Nested source/provider timings are not added to these outer totals.

verification.cpu_scope: Supervisor parent; waited child plus reaped descendant accounting reported by Linux. Nested source/provider timings are not added to these outer totals.

retained_provider_facts.extraction_scope: Selected fields copied without reinterpretation from the original FACTS receipt; no provider or native re-execution.

original_verdict.scope: local original-byte integrity and actual native mechanism measurements; deterministic task and controller fixtures
